$comment: Plan W10.G10: one entry per top-level Codex review comment that mentions P2 on the W1.32 PRs. Edit this file, then run `npm run p2:ledger`; `npm run p2:ledger -- --check --fetch` checks it against GitHub (REST).
title: P2 ledger — W1.32 (W10.G10)
intro: Every top-level Codex review comment that mentions P2 on the 12 W1.32 PRs (#199, #201, #202, #204, #210, #211, #218, #225, #231, #232, #235, #238), from `gh api repos/talstilkol/lumen-md/pulls/N/comments` on 14.11 (REST; replies matched by `in_reply_to_id`), with its decision.
method: How each decision was reached: a "Fixed in <sha>" reply in the thread (the sha checked against verify/train-4 fcf760fde8, by ancestry or by the same commit subject when the PR was rebased); otherwise the W1.32 commit on train-4 titled "Codex P2 on #N", whose message names the finding; otherwise the decline reason in the thread, docs/known-limits.md, or the lane D owner-checklist decisions. A comment none of these covers is **open**. Re-checked on 16.11 (`npm run p2:ledger -- --check --fetch`, lane B2c): every fixed commit is in verify/train-7 063d3d2c82 (a rebased one through the commit of the same subject, `inHead` in plan/p2-ledger.json), and the three #235 comments open on 14.11 are fixed by 1334460696; one P2 comment posted later on #235 is new and open.
